newsitem.title: CANADA: Placer to make Mulatos mine decision.
newsitem.headline: Placer to make Mulatos mine decision.

text.p: Placer Dome Inc said Wednesday that it expects to decide in September whether to build a mine at its Mulato gold property in Mexico.

Placer said it will complete a feasibility study on the project this quarter. "The property is considered commercially viable and is being evaluated in terms of the corporation's criteria for quality mines," it said.

Mulatos has an indicated resource estimated to contain two million ounces of gold which could be recovered by heap leaching to produce 1.25 million ounces of gold and 785,000 ounces of silver over eight years.
